facts.fact: The notice states the Direction of Communal Finances is considering an IT solution to replace the current system of manual collection of communal taxes; undated, so the notice's year 2021 (inferred from the mission window) is used.

The notice calls for a study across all 119 communes to establish, among other things, whether each has communal-tax software, and states no commune with a system; the current system is described as manual collection (notice dated 2021 by inference).
The Ministry of the Interior's Direction of Communal Finances envisages acquiring an IT system for communal revenue; UNDP funds only a feasibility study (mission 15 August to 15 December 2021).
